title: Recent iOS fixes
lede: All 11 review findings are fixed in the combined feature checkout. Native recovery paths were exercised on iPhone 18 Pro Max.

sections.heading: An active license remains usable
sections.note: Same device, empty pool, active claim, appearance, type size and scroll.

pairs.title: Pool empty; holder still active
pairs.beforeCap: The empty pool hid the existing holder’s code and recovery actions.
pairs.afterCap: Copy, History, Return and broken-code actions remain available.

changes.was: Extracted API files were absent; deleted cache source remained registered.
changes.now: Regenerated project includes all API extensions, response shapes, and the legacy cache replacement.

changes.was: Historical or frozen cards could name currently hidden/inactive people.
changes.now: New and frozen identity cards honor current visibility while aggregate totals remain historical.

changes.was: A pending response could reveal a password after background clearing.
changes.now: Clearing invalidates pending requests as well as revealed secrets.
Successful top-level dismissal clears its retry state.

changes.was: Search lacked local authentication and omitted bulk families.
changes.now: Local authentication is required; both serialized and bulk rows are projected.

changes.was: A People scope concealed a scanned bulk family.
changes.now: A successful family scan selects Gear before publishing results.

changes.was: Personal API counts were described as team totals and team lanes could never populate.
changes.now: The summary, overdue/pickup queue and fixture data follow scope=ios-home; unreachable lanes are removed.

changes.was: All six areas were rejected; a real 0% could appear as missing.
changes.now: Enum-sized bounds accept every area. Web/native labels preserve 0% versus nil, including VoiceOver.

verification: Wisconsin build on iPhone 18 Pro Max / iOS 27.0: passed.
Native tests: 251 passed; source/API contracts: 821 passed; broader backend cases: 135 passed.
Simulator UI: 7 passed (full required student walkthrough, accessibility-size selections, and all five review regression paths).
TypeScript, touched-file ESLint (111 files), build:app, generated project membership, docs/codemaps, and audit inventory (82/82): passed.
Independent backend and native reviews: no actionable regressions.

The ios:xcode:verify wrapper stops at 11 pre-existing drift hits (7 literal status tints, 2 gestures, 2 already-formatted area labels). Direct build and simulator tests above passed; wrapper is not green.
notes: All work is unstaged on codex/ios-review-fixes. Root product files and pending branches were preserved. No commit, push, deployment, migration execution, email, or distribution occurred.

Before/after sources combine the exact pending PR revisions in baseline-sources.json. Xcode membership was regenerated as a prerequisite to render the pre-fix app. Identical DEBUG fixture additions supply the rare empty-pool state to both binaries. Runtime image captures verify the installed binary hash in runtime-captures.json.
Fixture proof is separate from authenticated server/DB behavior, real Siri lock-screen policy, physical camera scans, APNs, and installed-device/distribution acceptance.
Existing Wrapped UIScreen.main deprecation warning remains.
After-only interaction captures: home.png, shared-password.png, bulk-scan.png and comparison.png. These demonstrate final states; only the license pair is a matched before/after.
